continuity: The elderly owner of Poison Flower Pavilion is the Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent planted in Yeongin; he speaks both the local language and Chinese and has recognized Jin Taekyung.

A Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group from Sichuan, consisting of one woman and nearly thirty men, arrived in Yeongin more than fifteen days earlier and was associated with the overnight massacre of approximately two hundred nearby villagers.
Every member of the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group was found dead after being poisoned by deadly venom; Taekyung cannot pursue them.
The innkeeper did not recognize the likeness of the Southern Heaven Demon Empress, so whether she was the woman in the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group remains unresolved.
Yeongin’s hostility toward Han Chinese is a consequence of the massacre attributed to that group.
plot: The Fire Dragon Pavilion reaches Poison Flower Pavilion in Yeongin, where the locals’ hostility toward Han Chinese has intensified because a group from the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau allegedly slaughtered roughly two hundred villagers before all of its members died from venom. After paying an exploitative innkeeper for food and information, Taekyung learns that the group came from Sichuan and included a woman who might have been the Southern Heaven Demon Empress, though the innkeeper does not recognize her likeness. The innkeeper then reveals himself as the elderly Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent they came to contact and identifies Taekyung as the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon.
translation_decisions: Render 天魔镖局 as Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau.
Render 蛮族 as Man people.
Retain Poison Flower Pavilion for 독화루 and Blazing Flame Divine Dragon for 열화신룡.

active_continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion has reached Yeongin and is staying at Poison Flower Pavilion.
The elderly Poison Flower Pavilion owner is the Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent planted in Yeongin and has identified Jin Taekyung.
Yeongin’s inhabitants are hostile toward Han Chinese because a Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group allegedly massacred approximately two hundred nearby villagers.
The Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group came from Sichuan, included one woman and nearly thirty men, and all of them later died from deadly venom.
The woman in the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group may have been the Southern Heaven Demon Empress, but the innkeeper did not recognize her likeness and she may have used a disguise technique.
The Nanman Beast Palace remains the Fire Dragon Pavilion’s primary mission objective.
The Peak-grade Chain Quest requiring contact with a Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent in Nanman has reached its contact stage in Yeongin.
open_questions: Was the woman in the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group the Southern Heaven Demon Empress?
Who poisoned and killed the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group, and why?
What information or assistance will the Hidden Shadow Pavilion agent provide?
What dangers and plans await the Fire Dragon Pavilion at the Nanman Beast Palace?
temporary_decisions: Render 天魔镖局 as Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau.
Render 蛮族 as Man people.
Continue rendering 永仁 as Yeongin and 毒华楼 as Poison Flower Pavilion.

names.notes: A Sichuan group whose arrival preceded the Yeongin massacre; all members were later found dead from venom.
An ethnic group mentioned by the Poison Flower Pavilion owner.
